About Me

Hi there! My name is Ruilin Wu, and you can call me Ryan.
I am a senior Biology and Computer Science student.


I am fascinated by the beauty and complexity of biological systems, and I am eager to use computational methods to unravel the mysteries of life. I aspire to be a scientist studying in the joint field of Bio and CS, such as Systems Biology, Computational Biology, and Bioinformatics.


In my free time, I enjoy working out, watching movies, listening to good music, and exploring new restaurants.
Thank you for visiting my website!

Inspiration

Heading into my last few months of college, I, like many others, have been constantly looking for where to go for the next chapter of my life. Looking back at what I have accomplished for the past few years to determine what I want to do in the future, I realized I did not have a personal space to share my identity and announce my existence.


That is why I created this personal website. Here, I will document my journey as a student and a researcher. This is a space to present my work, build my identity, and share my passions.


This is a celebration and exhibition of who I am beyond academics and research. I hope you enjoy exploring it as much as I enjoyed creating it!
